title: Algebra Structures of Multiple Eisenstein Series in Positive Characteristic
summary: In [CCHT25], the authors introduced multiple Eisenstein series of arbitrary rank in positive characteristic and the $q$-shuffle algebra $\mathcal{E}$ associated with them. In the present paper, we establish a class of linear independence results for multiple Eisenstein series. We also prove that the $q$-shuffle algebra $\mathcal{R}$ of multiple zeta values embeds into the inverse limit of the spaces of multiple Eisenstein series with respect to the rank $r$, and that $\mathcal{E}$ is isomorphic to the tensor square of $\mathcal{R}$.
